If it helps, I've converted no less than 4 people. You get both the zen of grind and the adrenaline of snap decisions while you're surrounded by elite mobs.

Also, turn it up to Monsoon.

I didn't like the last Risk of Rain. I picked it up in January and put it down after 6 hours because the minimal graphics and labyrinthine maps made getting through the stages fast enough a chore. This is not the case here.

This is the best transition to 3D I think I've ever seen. The maps don't change now, but they're big enough to make the random placement of chests and the teleporter to the next stage constitute its own variation of the map, and the teleporter gives off red particles so it is easier to see.

These are just the icing on the cake however, as EVERY SINGLE CHARACTER AND ITEM has already been fine-tuned to work in this environment. I could not believe how well they pulled off a mele-only character when I first played as The Mercenary.

Sure, the game is still in EA, but this game has enough single player content to keep new players satisfied for now, and the next update is just around the corner. I haven't tried the multiplayer, so you may want to look into that in the discussions tab or other reviews.

I love this game its something very new and refreshing to play. It has great graphics, smooth mechanics and progression is super from from going from nothing to almost a god within a few levels. The only problem i have with the game is it keeps crashing on me. Im not sure if its cause of my graphics card is super new or what not but I was able to play it for a few hours and now I cant get past round 2 without it freezing and crashing. I know its early access so Im going to wait for it to be fixed but man this is amazing cant wait to play more.
